description: Approved article sources for Relay. This is a tightly curated specialist whitelist, mirroring the Relay Videos source-first approach: the publisher list itself is the primary relevance filter, not a large keyword or scoring system. Set enabled:true only after a source's configured feed URL passes: node relay-automation/update-articles.js --verify-feeds

automatic_sources.content_focus: Severe weather, floods, tropical cyclones, earthquakes, volcanoes, space-weather hazards, and concrete warnings or disruptions.
automatic_sources.exclusion_notes: Reject generic explainers, historical retrospectives, unrelated astronomy content, promotional material, and duplicate versions of the same event.
automatic_sources.verification_notes: node relay-automation/update-articles.js --verify-feeds (2026-07-24): status=valid http_status=200 format=rss entries=10, approved-hostname links confirmed.

automatic_sources.content_focus: Recalls, outbreaks, contamination, investigations, enforcement, government warnings, and foodborne illness.
automatic_sources.exclusion_notes: Reject opinion, recipes, general guidance, evergreen explainers, sponsored material, and event promotion.
automatic_sources.verification_notes: node relay-automation/update-articles.js --verify-feeds (2026-07-24): status=valid http_status=200 format=rss entries=15, approved-hostname links confirmed.

automatic_sources.content_focus: Cyberattacks, ransomware, active exploitation, confirmed breaches, infrastructure attacks, ICS/OT incidents, and major government cyber warnings.
automatic_sources.exclusion_notes: Reject funding, acquisitions, appointments, product launches, webinars, podcasts, opinion, generic advice, and conference promotion.
automatic_sources.verification_notes: node relay-automation/update-articles.js --verify-feeds (2026-07-24): status=valid http_status=200 format=rss entries=10, approved-hostname links confirmed. (Previously existed in sources.json with an empty feed_url.)

automatic_sources.content_focus: Outbreaks, public-health emergencies, contamination, government health warnings, hospital-system disruption, and concrete disease or safety developments.
automatic_sources.exclusion_notes: Reject First Opinion, podcasts, events, routine pharmaceutical business news, investor news, appointments, wellness content, and evergreen explainers.
automatic_sources.verification_notes: node relay-automation/update-articles.js --verify-feeds (2026-07-24): status=valid http_status=200 format=rss entries=20, approved-hostname links confirmed.

automatic_sources.content_focus: Grid problems, utility emergencies, outages, shutoffs, electricity shortages, infrastructure failures, concrete energy disruptions, and reliability warnings.
automatic_sources.exclusion_notes: Reject broad policy analysis without a current event, product announcements, funding stories, general explainers, profiles, and opinion.
automatic_sources.verification_notes: node relay-automation/update-articles.js --verify-feeds (2026-07-24): status=valid http_status=200 format=rss entries=100, approved-hostname links confirmed. (Previously existed in sources.json with an empty feed_url.)

automatic_sources.content_focus: Ransomware, major breaches, active exploitation, operational outages, critical vulnerabilities, infrastructure incidents, major malware campaigns, and government or vendor warnings.
automatic_sources.exclusion_notes: Reject tutorials, how-to guides, downloads, deals, product promotion, forum posts, and general software advice.
automatic_sources.verification_notes: node relay-automation/update-articles.js --verify-feeds (2026-07-24): status=valid http_status=200 format=rss entries=15, approved-hostname links confirmed.
